method.source: embedded baseColor image in each authored runtime LOD GLB
method.resize: Pillow Lanczos into a 512x512 bounding box, aspect preserved
method.visible_texel_rule: include texels only when max(sRGB RGB) > 0.08
method.rgb_statistics: arithmetic mean and per-channel median of visible encoded sRGB bytes
method.hsv_statistics: per-channel median after encoded sRGB RGB-to-HSV conversion
method.purpose: deterministic cliff-calibrated terrain albedo grade reference

runtime_resolution_rationale: True 2K is the visual-quality floor after the rejected low-resolution pass. At 4-8 m scene repeats it supplies 256-512 texels/m; future GPU block compression should reduce the honestly recorded decoded cost without reducing authored resolution.

scene_scale_calibration.source_span_policy: physical_span_m records source/capture provenance and does not drive runtime UVs
scene_scale_calibration.runtime_span_policy: scene_repeat_m is the complete world-XZ texture repeat used by the shader
scene_scale_calibration.seedthree_derivation: 560 m terrain / 140 base repeats = 4 m; rock UV multiplier 0.55 gives 4 / 0.55 = 7.272727 m

albedo_packing.RGB: graded sRGB albedo; decoded to the renderer working color space
albedo_packing.A: linear per-source relative displacement height encoded as UNORM8
albedo_packing.alpha_color_conversion: none; sRGB transfer applies to RGB only
albedo_packing.height_use: bounded transition-weight bias only; not displacement or SPOM

channel_packing.R: renormalized tangent-space NormalGL X encoded as UNORM8
channel_packing.G: renormalized tangent-space NormalGL Y encoded as UNORM8
channel_packing.A: linear ambient occlusion encoded as UNORM8

albedo_grade.detail_policy: local scan luminance retained; only modest exposure/contrast and per-layer chroma alignment

height_alpha.normalization: source 1st-99th percentile remapped to linear UNORM8 0-1

future_spom_height.reason: The normalized 2K alpha is active only for bounded material-transition weighting. Geometric displacement/SPOM remains disabled; the authored 4K master is retained for that later implementation.
